name: bosfoot-web
description: Lint config for the browser JS modules + convenience wrappers for the Go dev/ops commands. The app has no build step; Biome is used only as a linter to catch runtime-fatal mistakes (e.g. use-before-declaration) that node --check can't see. Run `npm run help` to list every command. Pass flags after `--`, e.g. `npm run reviews -- -approve 12`.

scripts.help: printf '%s\n' 'Bosfoot commands — pass flags after --, e.g. npm run reviews -- -approve 12' '' 'DEV' '  dev             live-reload server (go tool air)' '  serve           server, no live reload' '  check           Biome lint + format check (what CI runs)' '  lint            Biome lint only' '  format          Biome apply formatting' '' 'CONTENT / DATA' '  db-import       load schema + seed + migrations into the DB (idempotent)' '  stock-import    import products/stock from data/, rebuilds from JSON (DRY-RUN; add -- -commit)' '  add-stock       add inventory to existing variants, live-safe (DRY-RUN; e.g. -- -product vibe-2 -color Black -add 43:2 -commit)' '  add-brands      seed the coming-soon brands + translations' '  article-import  load foot-health articles from db/articles.json' '  img-variants    generate ~500px -card image variants (needs ImageMagick)' '' 'ORDERS / REVIEWS' '  orders          list orders, newest first (-- -status pending, -- -limit 10)' '  reservations    export reservation CSVs (what to order + who to contact)' '  review-invites  send post-purchase review invites (-- -order <id> -commit)' '  reviews         moderate reviews (-- -approve <id> / -- -reject <id> / -- -delete <id>)' '' 'DIAGNOSTICS' '  db-ping         test the database connection'
